title: Spicy Italian Chicken Breast
description: A spicy Italian-inspired chicken breast dish, perfect for a quick weeknight dinner. The combination of garlic, syrian, and spiced flavors will leave you wanting more.
instructions: Season the chicken breast with spiced and garlic.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear the chicken breast for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until browned.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 15-20 minutes, or until cooked through.
Let the chicken rest for 5 minutes before slicing.
Garnish with syrian herbs and serve.
